Review Team Attendance and Overtime

User manual · English · 9 steps
Learn how a manager checks when the team checks in and out, how many hours each person worked, how much overtime they have, and how attendance trends over recent weeks.

1. Open Attendances

Open the Attendances app.

2. Team timeline

This timeline shows each day of the period. Click it to continue.

3. List view

Click List to see the attendance records as a table.

4. Employee totals

Click an employee's name to open their records.

5. Work Hours

The Work Hours column shows the time between check-in and check-out. Click it to continue.

6. Over Time

The Over Time column shows the extra hours worked. Click it to continue.

7. Reporting

Open Reporting to see attendance trends.

8. Chart settings

These tags show the period and grouping of the chart. Click one to continue.

9. Pivot view

Click Pivot to see the same figures in a table.
